g.text: Share of each sector's firms in each tier; rows sum to 100%. Firm count in brackets. Sectors below 25 firms are dropped, as are the 2,943 firms whose only label is a document-filing category rather than a sector.
The ramp is applied within each row: one ramp across the whole table would be dominated by the `none` tier and every other cell would sit in the palest step.
